events.label: Russell new indexes live + NVDA Stop Day 2 + Quarter-end week opens
events.note: Russell 2026 reconstitution takes effect at Monday June 29 open. NVDA is now the #1 constituent in the Russell 3000/1000 Growth; MU and AMD are 100% Growth. The June 26 closing cross was a record $334.027B in 1.63 seconds — passive bid overwhelmed by active selling (NVDA -1.64%, MU -2.1%, AMD -2.6%). June 29 is ALSO: (1) NVDA Stop Day 2 — close above $195 resets stop; close below $195 triggers mandatory FULL EXIT; (2) Samsung Blue House $648B CATALYST FAILED — KOSPI -3.05% (intraday -5.81%) despite largest-ever Korean national AI plan; SK Hynix -1.83%, below ₩2,700K long entry threshold; fourth consecutive catalyst failure since June 22; (3) US-Iran 'stand down' confirmed — ES +1.4% pre-market, VIX testing 16.41 (below 17 gate) for first time since regime shift; (4) $165B quarter-end institutional selling (JPMorgan) concentrated today-tomorrow. Watch: SPX close above 7,460 AND VIX close below 17 simultaneously = STEP ASIDE → HOLD upgrade.

events.label: Quarter-end / Q2 2026 close — $165B institutional selling settling
events.note: Q2 2026 close. US-Iran stand-down drove ES to 7,455 pre-market (+1.4% vs SPX 7,354 Friday close). JPMorgan estimates $165B in equity sales settling today: US pensions $55B, Japan GPIF $60B, Norway Norges Bank $40B, Swiss National Bank $25B. VIX at 16.41 pre-market (first below-17 reading since regime shift) — MUST CLOSE below 17 today AND again June 30 to formally clear the VIX gate. Samsung Blue House $648B catalyst FAILED Korean markets June 29 (KOSPI -3.05%) — fourth consecutive catalyst failure. Quarter-end close below 7,300 activates BEARISH escalation framework. Close above 7,460 AND VIX below 17 two consecutive closes = HOLD upgrade.

events.label: ISM Manufacturing Index (10:00 AM ET) — first Q3 economic read
events.note: June ISM Manufacturing official release — first Q3 data point. May 2026 ISM was 54.0 (beating forecasts of 53). June flash PMI Manufacturing was 55.7 (49-month high per S&P Global). ISM above 57 = goldilocks for AI/semis heading into Q3 (strong demand, oil disinflation). ISM below 50 = first recessionary data point since the BofA rate-hike repricing — forces regime re-evaluation and likely breaks SPX through 7,300. Key early-Q3 positioning catalyst.

events.label: June Non-Farm Payrolls 8:30 AM ET — consensus 114K (PULLED FORWARD; markets closed July 3)
events.note: June employment report pulled forward from July 3 to Thursday July 2 (markets closed July 3, Independence Day observed). Consensus REVISED DOWN to +114K (from prior +172K May print) — below the soft-landing corridor floor. THREE SCENARIOS: (1) STRONG (+150K+, wages +0.4%) = BofA three-hike framework (Sep/Oct/Dec 2026) locked in; DXY spikes; 30Y approaches 5.00% trigger; SPX gaps lower July 7 — STEP ASIDE escalates to BEARISH. (2) GOLDILOCKS (90-150K, wages +0.2%) = regime conditions stabilize; HOLD upgrade possible for first Q3 briefing; IWM/QQQ pair and TLT hedge both exit. (3) WEAK (<90K, wages flat) = recession fears emerge; Fed hike narrative collapses; TLT long pays off but growth tech faces 'bad news is bad news' further selling. Markets closed July 3 — NFP reaction prints into a 3-day weekend gap; positions cannot be hedged until July 7 open.

events.label: US Market Holiday — Independence Day observed (July 4 falls on Saturday)
events.note: US equity markets closed Friday July 3 as July 4, 2026 falls on a Saturday. 3-day weekend gap (July 3-6). The June NFP report prints Thursday July 2 — any repricing accumulates over the full 3-day gap before July 7 open. Use July 2 close as the last chance to hedge or reduce before the gap.

events.label: SPCX added to Nasdaq-100 Index — ~$4.3B forced passive inflows from QQQ/QQQM
events.note: SPCX (SpaceX) inclusion in Nasdaq-100 Index effective July 7, 2026 — QQQ/QQQM forced to buy ~$4.3B of SPCX to match index weight. This is a mechanical passive-flow catalyst. Current SPCX price ~$153 with IG floor at $150 (bond distribution). Step-aside HIGH conviction on SPCX applies until bond distribution window clears. Nasdaq-100 inclusion is NOT a fundamental catalyst; it is a passive-flow event. Watch pre-inclusion volume in the July 3-6 holiday gap. Note: July 7 open is ALSO the post-NFP holiday gap return day — two simultaneous catalysts (NFP repricing + SPCX passive flow) create higher-than-normal volatility.

events.label: FOMC Minutes from June 17 meeting (est.) — first post-dot-plot-removal release
events.note: Minutes from the June 17 FOMC meeting (est. release ~3 weeks after meeting). This is the first FOMC at which Warsh removed the dot plot — minutes will reveal the internal rate debate and degree of committee division on the Sep/Oct/Dec 2026 hike sequence BofA is forecasting. Unanimous hawkish tone = BofA 3-hike forecast solidified. Any dissent or hike-pause language = dovish surprise and rate relief. Key input for Q3 positioning heading into the July 14 CPI print.

events.label: SK Hynix ADR Nasdaq listing — $29.4B offering, 17.79M shares (potentially largest ADR in history)
events.note: SK Hynix Nasdaq ADR listing — $29.4B offering (17.79M shares). Underwriters: BofA, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, JPMorgan — largest ADR institutional underwriting consortium in Nasdaq history. If fully subscribed, the largest ADR in history. June 29 context: KOSPI sold -3.05% (intraday -5.81%) on Samsung Blue House $648B; SK Hynix -1.83% below ₩2,700K long entry threshold. ADR stability depends on KOSPI stabilization above 8,500 and SK Hynix reclaiming ₩2,700K on two consecutive sessions before July 10. Underwriter stabilization mandate (BofA/Goldman/Citigroup/JPMorgan) provides ADR floor support. Full exit review on SK Hynix Q2 KST earnings ~July 29.

events.label: June CPI release (est.) — most important inflation data of the summer
events.note: June CPI is the next major inflation recalibration after May PCE (June 25, 4.1% YoY hotter than expected). US-Iran stand-down confirmed June 29 — Brent at $72/bbl, Hormuz normalization intact. June CPI captures the first full month of Iran peace deal normalization. If CPI falls to 3.5% or below, the BofA 3-hike framework weakens materially and the July 28 FOMC hike probability collapses. If CPI holds at 4.0%+, September hike is locked in. July 14 is the critical regime-reset date for H2 2026 positioning.

events.label: FOMC meeting (July 28-29) — rate hike on the table
events.note: Nine of 18 FOMC officials projected at least one 2026 rate hike at the June 17 meeting (Warsh's first as Chair). BofA calls for three hikes (Sep/Oct/Dec). A 25-bps hike (3.50-3.75% → 3.75-4.00%) at this meeting is a non-trivial probability if June CPI disappoints. June CPI (~July 14) is the primary input. Rate hike = BEARISH regime confirmation. AI capex robust ($750B in 2026) but higher rates still compress growth multiples.

events.label: Iran-US Islamabad Declaration 60-day deadline — Hormuz full reopening + sanctions relief
events.note: Deal operational from June 18 MOU signing; 60-day window expires August 13. June 29 US-Iran 'stand down' confirmed — both sides agreed to halt tit-for-tat attacks ahead of technical talks. Brent at $72/bbl, Hormuz normalization proceeding. If August 13 deadline met with full Hormuz clearance, WTI could extend to $65-67 — extend XLE short and exit TBT. Failure = oil spike reversal and energy re-rally. The oil-crash pace is ahead of schedule relative to the original June 18 MOU framework.

events.label: SPCX first earnings as a public company (approx.) — Starlink ARR + Starship cadence
events.note: First earnings print since the June 12 IPO. SPCX confirmed in Russell 1000 effective June 29. Capital structure: $75B IPO + $60B xAI acquisition + $20B bond offering = $155B in obligations. First earnings (Starlink subscriber/ARR growth, Starship launch cadence, cash burn rate) is the fundamental clearing event for re-entry. Two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume required before re-entry from current ~$153 range.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut, early investors and insiders can sell, materially expanding the ~4% public float. Lock-up expiries are a known supply overhang for hot IPOs; the $20B bond offering (June 22) already changed the capital structure risk profile — the lock-up expiry adds equity supply overhang on top. Exact date pending the prospectus's stated terms.

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window shifts to H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). SoftBank sold off -13% on the delay. Microsoft and NVIDIA hold strategic stakes. The delay removes a near-term AI sentiment catalyst and adds uncertainty to AI infrastructure spending trajectories. Monitor for filing date announcement as a potential AI sentiment catalyst. Date is approximate placeholder for H1 2027 window.
